metadata.title: AstroCare indicator library
metadata.note: Demonstration decision-support ranges only. Mission medical standards and flight surgeon guidance always supersede this file.

indicators.label: Resting heart rate
indicators.measure_in_space: Finger pulse oximeter or approved wearable, after 5 minutes seated and still.
indicators.why_exam: Microgravity shifts fluid toward the chest and changes cardiovascular loading; a baseline and trend make changes easier to spot.

actions.normal: Continue the planned schedule and recheck at the next daily window.
actions.attention: Pause strenuous work, sit or secure yourself, recheck after 5 minutes, and notify the crew medical officer if it persists.
actions.critical: Stop the task and contact the crew medical officer and flight surgeon now; follow the mission emergency protocol.

status_messages.normal: Cardiovascular signal is inside the demo baseline.
status_messages.attention: A repeat reading is useful before making a decision.
status_messages.critical: This value is outside the demo safety envelope.

indicators.label: Systolic blood pressure
indicators.measure_in_space: Approved automated cuff with the arm supported at the mission-defined position.
indicators.why_exam: Fluid redistribution and cardiovascular deconditioning can change vascular responses in flight.

actions.normal: Keep the reading in the mission log with the time and posture.
actions.attention: Repeat with correct cuff placement after resting; share the trend with the flight surgeon.
actions.critical: Stop and escalate to the crew medical officer / flight surgeon now, especially with chest pain, faintness, weakness, or severe headache.

status_messages.normal: Pressure is inside the demo baseline.
status_messages.attention: The trend and symptoms matter; confirm the measurement.
status_messages.critical: Treat as an urgent out-of-range signal, not a diagnosis.

indicators.label: Oxygen saturation
indicators.measure_in_space: Approved pulse oximeter with warm, still finger and a stable signal indicator.
indicators.why_exam: Cabin atmosphere, suit operations, and equipment issues can affect oxygen availability and crew performance.

actions.normal: Continue the planned schedule and log the reading.
actions.attention: Check sensor fit and cabin/suit context, repeat promptly, and notify the crew medical officer.
actions.critical: Stop activity, move to the approved safe configuration, and contact the crew medical officer and flight surgeon immediately.

status_messages.normal: Oxygenation signal is inside the demo baseline.
status_messages.attention: Confirm sensor quality and environmental context.
status_messages.critical: Potential oxygenation emergency signal — escalate immediately.

indicators.label: Body temperature
indicators.measure_in_space: Approved thermometer; record route, time, recent exercise, and any fever symptoms.
indicators.why_exam: A closed habitat can increase infection and heat-management concerns; symptom context is essential.

actions.normal: Log the reading with any symptoms and continue the planned check cadence.
actions.attention: Rest, repeat using the same approved method, and contact the crew medical officer for persistent elevation or symptoms.
actions.critical: Isolate per mission protocol and contact the crew medical officer and flight surgeon now.

status_messages.normal: Temperature is inside the demo baseline.
status_messages.attention: A persistent change or symptoms warrant a clinical review.
status_messages.critical: Treat as an urgent illness signal until assessed.

indicators.label: Sleep in last 24 h
indicators.measure_in_space: Self-report from sleep log or wearable; include awakenings and subjective restfulness.
indicators.why_exam: Isolation, workload, and circadian desynchronization can reduce sleep and degrade performance before a crew member notices.

actions.normal: Protect the next sleep window and keep the light / workload plan consistent.
actions.attention: Reduce nonessential workload, use the approved sleep routine, and flag two consecutive off-nights.
actions.critical: Notify the behavioral health / flight surgeon team today; do not self-medicate or alter a medication plan.

status_messages.critical: A severe sleep deficit needs mission-team attention.

indicators.label: Hydration confidence
indicators.measure_in_space: Self-report plus fluid log; use urine or other approved measures when scheduled.
indicators.why_exam: Fluid shifts, exercise, and increased calcium excretion can contribute to urinary health risk.

actions.normal: Keep the planned fluid and nutrition rhythm.
actions.attention: Review fluid intake and urine log with the crew medical officer; follow the approved hydration plan.
actions.critical: Report promptly, especially with flank pain, vomiting, confusion, or very low urine output.

status_messages.attention: The log needs a closer look.
status_messages.critical: Fluid balance may need prompt review.

indicators.label: Planned exercise completed
indicators.measure_in_space: Log completed aerobic and resistive minutes from the approved exercise device.
indicators.why_exam: Exercise is a primary countermeasure for bone, muscle, aerobic capacity, and cardiovascular changes in altered gravity.

actions.normal: Keep the prescribed combination of aerobic and resistive work.
actions.attention: Review schedule, equipment, and symptoms with the medical / operations team; do not chase a target while unwell.
actions.critical: Record the missed countermeasure and notify the flight surgeon / exercise specialist for a recovery plan.

status_messages.attention: A small miss is recoverable with a plan.
status_messages.critical: Repeated misses can affect mission readiness.

indicators.label: Grip strength vs. personal baseline
indicators.measure_in_space: Approved dynamometer, same posture and hand as the personal baseline.
indicators.why_exam: Unloading can reduce muscle strength; a repeatable functional measure helps detect change between larger assessments.

actions.normal: Continue the approved resistive exercise plan.
actions.attention: Repeat when rested and review exercise technique / workload with the specialist.
actions.critical: Avoid safety-critical exertion and contact the crew medical officer for an assessment.

status_messages.normal: Strength is close to the personal baseline.
status_messages.attention: A repeat under consistent conditions is recommended.

indicators.label: Mood check
indicators.measure_in_space: Private self-report; pair the number with a short note about stressors, connection, and function.
indicators.why_exam: Isolation and confinement can influence mood, cognition, teamwork, and task performance.

actions.normal: Keep social connection, recreation, and private check-in time in the schedule.
actions.attention: Tell a trusted crew member and schedule a private behavioral-health check-in; use approved coping tools.
actions.critical: Do not stay alone with a worsening crisis; alert the crew immediately and follow the behavioral-health emergency protocol.

status_messages.attention: Support now can prevent a larger performance impact.

indicators.label: Perceived stress
indicators.measure_in_space: Private self-report; note workload, conflict, uncertainty, and ability to recover.
indicators.why_exam: Stressors can compound with sleep loss and isolation, affecting attention and team performance.

actions.normal: Protect the routines that keep stress manageable.
actions.attention: Use a brief approved reset, reduce nonessential load, and contact behavioral health if it lasts.
actions.critical: Contact the crew medical officer and behavioral-health support immediately; stay connected to the crew.

status_messages.normal: Stress is within the self-management range.
status_messages.attention: A support action is worth taking today.

indicators.label: Reaction time
indicators.measure_in_space: Short approved computer-based test at a consistent time, device, and posture.
indicators.why_exam: Sleep loss, workload, stress, and radiation-related concerns can affect attention and motor response.

actions.normal: Continue the normal workload and recovery plan.
actions.attention: Delay safety-critical tasks where possible, recover, repeat the test, and notify the flight surgeon if persistent.
actions.critical: Do not operate safety-critical systems alone; alert the crew and flight surgeon immediately.

status_messages.normal: Reaction time is close to baseline.
status_messages.attention: Performance may benefit from recovery before critical work.

indicators.label: Cabin carbon dioxide
indicators.measure_in_space: Read the vehicle environmental monitoring display; compare with location and time.
indicators.why_exam: Closed habitats require continuous environmental monitoring because air quality can affect cognition and performance.

actions.normal: Continue monitoring and keep airflow / ventilation pathways clear.
actions.attention: Notify operations, move to the approved safe location if directed, and repeat the monitor check.
actions.critical: Treat as an environmental emergency: follow vehicle alarm and evacuation / mask procedures immediately.

status_messages.normal: Cabin CO₂ is inside the demo operating range.
status_messages.attention: Operations should inspect the trend and ventilation context.
status_messages.critical: Environmental alarm condition — follow the vehicle procedure.

indicators.label: Radiation dose in last 24 h
indicators.measure_in_space: Read the personal dosimeter and mission radiation console; use cumulative and event context.
indicators.why_exam: Ionizing radiation is a cumulative hazard and can be episodic; exposure data informs shielding and task decisions.

actions.normal: Keep the dosimeter on and follow the mission exposure plan.
actions.attention: Notify operations, minimize nonessential exposure, and move to the designated shelter if directed.
actions.critical: Follow the radiation-event procedure and contact mission control; do not improvise exposure countermeasures.

status_messages.normal: No dose alert in the demo reading.
status_messages.attention: Operations context and cumulative dose matter.
